newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gunmen shoot at motorists in Rio, kill two.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gunmen shoot at motorists in Rio, kill two.

text.p: Brazilian gunmen blocked a road leading to a Rio de Janeiro slum and started shooting indiscriminately at passing motorists, killing two people, local Globo television said on Sunday.
Globo showed one car riddled with bullet holes in the shooting which took place on Saturday night. Its male driver was hit in the head and died being taken to a hospital, it said.
A woman also died after being shot six times. She had been in a van with her husband and two children. Her husband was in a hospital in a serious condition but the two children were unharmed.
The woman's 11-year-old daughter told Globo that one of the attackers was a young boy who appeared to be only between 8- and 10-years old.
"People are afraid to go out in the car, they are afraid to go out with their children, they have no more freedom," said Milma Tedeshi Sa, cousin of the murdered woman.
A military police officer told Globo the street was normally patrolled by police at night but that surveillance had been called off bn Saturday because of heavy rains.
